meta.title: Automated Identity and Bank Verification: refused for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the MDM/Master Data Team role and attempt Automated Identity and Bank Verification for PAN, GST, bank, and MSME verification.
Repeat the verification as an MDM/Master Data Team user and compare whether the action is available or succeeds.
Observe the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
